case_title: Mukesh Chand v. State(NCT) of Delhi & Anr
neutral_facts: The accused was a consumer of electricity who obtained a connection from BSES for his business premises. BSES sent a bill for electricity consumption amounting to Rs. 3,54,598.21. The accused failed to pay the bill, leading BSES to file an FIR against him under Section 135 of the Electricity Act, 2003. The accused and BSES settled the matter in a Special Lok Adalat for a total sum of Rs. 1,60,000. The accused then filed a petition under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code to quash the FIR. The High Court dismissed the petition, leading to these appeals. The Supreme Court remanded the case to the High Court for reconsideration in light of Section 152 of the Electricity Act, which deals with compounding of offences.
